This '''battle''' was contested in the [[Tionese War]] between the young [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Honorable Union of Desevro and Tion|Honorable Union of Desevro & Tion]], over control of the Republic trade world of [[Tirahnn/Legends|Tirahnn]]. Coming off of victories at [[Abhean/Legends|Abhean]], [[Roche asteroid field|Roche]] and [[Lantillies/Legends|Lantillies]], the Tionese succeeded in conquering Tirahnn.
